title: How she wants to be remembered

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: One last question. How would you like to be remembered?
I’m going to name one of my songs: A Lady with a Song would sum it up for me.
Thank you. {transcribed and edited by Barry Kernfeld) {corrections and annotations by Devra Hall Levy}
